# Hand-labelled intent corpus. Format: <expected-mode> <TAB> <prompt>
#
# WHY THIS FILE IS HAND-WRITTEN AND NOT SAMPLED
#   There is no ground truth to sample from: the live audit stream
#   (~/.gemini/logs/srp_guardian_live.json) records file events, never prompts.
#   So the corpus is hand-written, which means it cannot prove the classifier is
#   right about REAL users — only that a change to the signals does not break
#   what the author already understood. That is the honest claim, and it is
#   still worth a gate: signal edits are exactly the kind of change that
#   silently flips a mode and nobody notices until a prompt comes out wrong.
#
# One prompt per line. No tabs inside the prompt. Blank lines and #-comments are
# skipped. Expectations are the MODE a competent agent should act in, not the
# words used to express it — "how should I..." is a question, not a build order.
